principles.title: Clarity before novelty
principles.text: A visitor should understand what the business is, why it matters and what to do next before decorative interaction asks for attention.

principles.title: One primary action per context
principles.text: Each section should have a clear purpose and one dominant next step. Secondary actions remain visually subordinate.

principles.title: Proof near the decision
principles.text: Place reviews, work, credentials, process or concrete evidence close to the action they support rather than isolating all proof on one page.

principles.title: Progressive disclosure
principles.text: Keep the first read concise. Use Accordion, ContentSwitcher, Carousel or deeper routes for information that helps interested users without overwhelming everyone.

principles.title: Motion communicates
principles.text: Reveal hierarchy, progression, chronology or relationships with motion. Do not animate merely because an element can move.

principles.title: Trust is conversion
principles.text: Accessibility, honest wording, clear pricing or process, useful contact information and fast loading increase confidence and are part of conversion design.

principles.title: Mobile is a first-class composition
principles.text: Touch, reading order, short paths to action and lightweight media matter more than reproducing the desktop composition at a smaller size.

principles.title: Sustainable by default
principles.text: Prefer fewer stronger images, native browser behavior, lazy third-party embeds, efficient media and reusable components over decorative payload.

contexts.label: Restaurant / hospitality
contexts.goal: Create desire, remove practical uncertainty and move quickly toward reservation.
contexts.conversionNote: Put availability, address and reservation close to moments of appetite. Avoid forcing users through long storytelling before they can book.

contexts.label: Architect / architecture studio
contexts.goal: Demonstrate taste and competence, then make project fit and enquiry feel credible.
hierarchy: Timeline: process from brief to delivery
contexts.conversionNote: Portfolio proof comes before sales copy. The enquiry form can qualify project type, location, timing and approximate scope.

contexts.label: Musician / performer
contexts.goal: Turn attention into listening, attendance, following or booking.
contexts.conversionNote: Listening and dates should be immediately reachable. Separate fan actions from professional booking actions.

contexts.label: Artist / creative practice
contexts.goal: Let the work lead while making exhibitions, enquiries, commissions or sales understandable.
hierarchy: ScrollScene: one body of work or process
contexts.conversionNote: Avoid turning artwork into ecommerce cards unless buying is actually the task. Preserve image scale and context, then surface commercial actions deliberately.

contexts.label: Developer / designer / digital studio
contexts.goal: Prove capability and judgement, explain services, then generate qualified leads.
contexts.conversionNote: Lead with outcomes and finished work rather than a long tool list. Technical detail becomes progressive proof for visitors who need it.

contexts.label: Association / nonprofit
contexts.goal: Make the mission tangible and convert attention into participation, donation, membership or contact.
contexts.conversionNote: Show concrete impact, governance and where support goes. Avoid guilt-based pressure or vague impact claims; trust and transparency are core conversion mechanisms.

contexts.label: Green / ethical commerce
contexts.goal: Sell a useful product while substantiating environmental or social claims without greenwashing.
hierarchy: Timeline: supply chain or lifecycle when meaningful
Purchase CTA with clear delivery information
contexts.conversionNote: Specific evidence beats green language. State materials, origin, durability, repair, packaging and verified certifications where relevant; never imply environmental benefit that cannot be substantiated.
